name: Zombie Rush Survival 🧟‍♂️
desc:
Fight endless waves of zombies, get upgrades, defeat bosses, and build defenses to survive with your team!

🔫 Buy powerful weapons and upgrades
🧱 Place turrets, barricades, and traps!
👥 Team up with friends
🏆 Survive as many waves as you can

Each wave gets tougher. How far can you get?
